description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Warbreak Trumpeter, adding {R}.
When Warbreak Trumpeter dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Warbreak Trumpeter from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Warbreak Trumpeter's morph ability by paying {R}, turning it face up.
Warbreak Trumpeter triggers, creating zero tokens.
Repeat.
